translations.web: Thus he showed me and behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb line, with a plumb line in his hand.
translations.bsb: This is what He showed me: Behold, the Lord was standing by a wall true to plumb, with a plumb line in His hand.
translations.kjv: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.
translations.asv: Thus he showed me: and, behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb-line, with a plumb-line in his hand.
